description: iDesignRound Metal Waste Basket, The Patton Collection – 8" x 8" x 9.7", Brushed Stainless SteelDesigned with style and function in mind, the iDesign Formbu Round Metal Waste Can provides convenient trash disposal wherever you need it. The stylish brushed stainless-steel finish adds a contemporary look to any room. It is ideal for use in the bathroom, kitchen, office, bedroom, dorm, craft room, kitchen, living room, or any other space to provide convenient trash disposal wherever you need it. The bathroom garbage bin is constructed of durable steel for years of quality use and features a sturdy base to assure that your waste basket trash can stays upright and in place. This compact metal trash bin measures 8" x 8" x 9.7" to fit in small spaces throughout your home. With iDesign you can LiveSimply every day.iDesign Steel Toothbrush Holder Stand The York Collection – Four Divided Compartments, 3.25” x 3.25” x 5.75”, Brushed Nickel & Polished ChromeOrganize your bathroom vanity in style with the iDesign York Toothbrush Stand. This toothbrush holder features four divided compartments and a grooved base to keep toothbrushes upright and within reach by the sink. The functional open design provides proper airflow to dry wet toothbrushes and ensures items are always visible and accessible. Designed with versatility in mind, it can also be used to store makeup brushes, cosmetics, applicators, razors, and more. The classic design with dual-tone brushed nickel and polished chrome finish matches a variety of decor styles. The durable steel construction stands up to every day use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water, while the non-skid and non-absorbent foam padding on the bottom of the cup prevents it from sliding on wet surfaces. Measuring 3.25" x 3.25" x 5.75", this organizer is ideal for compact spaces on bathroom counters, in cabinets, or under the sink. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
